title: PCNME — scenario view

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "task" and r._field == "latency_s") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario =~ /^${scenario:regex}$/ and r.method =~ /^${method:regex}$/ and r.run_id =~ /^${run_id:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["method", "outcome"]) |> count()
  |> group(columns: ["method"]) |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value)}))

data = from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "task" and r._field == "latency_s") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario =~ /^${scenario:regex}$/ and r.method =~ /^${method:regex}$/ and r.run_id =~ /^${run_id:regex}$/) |> group(columns: ["method"])
p50 = data |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: (column, tables=<-) => tables |> quantile(q: 0.5, column: column)) |> set(key: "stat", value: "p50")
p99 = data |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: (column, tables=<-) => tables |> quantile(q: 0.99, column: column)) |> set(key: "stat", value: "p99")
union(tables: [p50, p99])
